name: acme-noisy-200
description: The Acme warehouse over one PostgreSQL schema of 200 tables, three that matter and 197 empty look-alikes (fixtures/noisy), with the structured owner persona. Runs only when PG_URL is set.
opening: Hi, I am Dana Ruiz, head of analytics at Acme. Our warehouse is connected as the source warehouse, through the variable PG_URL. Can you build the layer with me? There are a lot of tables in there, and only a few of them matter.
